title: Module Builder
description: The complete solution to build and ship Nuxt modules.
navigation:
  title: Getting Started
---

`@nuxt/module-builder` builds the modules described in the [Module Author Guide](/docs/guide/modules).

::code-group{sync="pm"}

```bash [npm]
npm install -D @nuxt/module-builder
```

```bash [pnpm]
pnpm add -D @nuxt/module-builder
```

::

Run it with [`nuxt build-module`](/docs/api/commands/build-module), or read about the [project structure](/docs/guide/modules/module-builder/project-structure).
